# Riché Zamor
> VP of Product. 2x Founder. Context Architect.

## About
Riché Zamor is a context architect and VP of Product who designs how organizations structure knowledge for AI-driven decision-making. He coined the term "context architecture" — a five-step framework (curate, synthesize, consolidate, prioritize, store intelligently) for turning raw data into decision-ready context.

## Ask Riché / Sia
Ask Riché is a live AI assistant grounded in Riché's writing, frameworks, and knowledge base. It runs on Claude Sonnet via Vercel AI Gateway at /api/chat (POST, streaming). Ask it about context architecture, Riché's work, or anything on the site. For direct inquiries, use https://www.richezamor.com/contact.
